newsitem.title: USA: American Mobile stake raised by investor.
newsitem.headline: American Mobile stake raised by investor.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said on Friday he raised his stake in American Mobile Satellite Corp to 5,492,833 common shares or 18.3 percent from 16.6 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said his latest transactions include the purchase of 519,000 common shares between January 7 and February 20 at prices ranging from $10.6250 to $13.6555 per share.
Based in Reston, Va., American Mobile operates North America's first high-powered, satellite-based mobile communications systems.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc BAMCO Inc and Baron Capital Inc, all based in New York.
